title: A Leslie Cheung Story: Hong Kong's Eternal Icon
original_title: A Leslie Cheung Story: Hong Kong's Eternal Icon
overview: A retrospective documentary on the life and times of Leslie Cheung, produced for the Shout. Studios, USA, Blu-ray release of A Chinese Ghost Story, considered one of the late, great actor and singer's finest achievements. Contributors include the famed director John Woo, who worked with Leslie on A Better Tomorrow in 1986.
